prompts: read through this codebase and iron out the edges and issues. i want you to design and add and implement a new feature. add a new button to run the ai word analysis feature with the ai model, with concurrency of a user customizable number of  words/phrases to be processed in parallel. this feature should only run on words which have not yet been processed with the ai word analysis, and the ai word analysis should be persisted. users should have the option to rerun an ai word analysis using the currently set ai model by clicking a button in the word/phrase detail view. also, the user should be able to navigate away and do other things while the batch ai word processing works in the background. maybe add the batch ai word processing and batch size to the settings menu, and let users navigate away or close the menu while it runs in the background. also, add a progress bar with a count of the successfully completed ai word analyses, and also add a cancel button that appears once it starts to the settings menu. even if users navigate away from the settings menu, and navigate back, they should be able to see the progress bar still running, with the live count. design, think through, and implement this feature well. put a lot of thought into this feature.maybe make the ai word analysis importable and exportable too, in the export and import words csv/json files
